description: Generates a self-contained HTML report of system health (CPU, memory, disks, network, errors).

fields.name: OutputDir
fields.label: Report folder
fields.helpText: Where the HTML report is written.

fields.name: OutputFile
fields.label: Report file name
fields.helpText: The file name of the generated HTML report.

fields.name: MaxTopProcesses
fields.label: Top processes to list
fields.helpText: How many processes appear in the Top Processes table.

fields.name: MaxErrorEvents
fields.label: Max error events
fields.helpText: Maximum number of recent error/critical events to list.

fields.name: ErrorWindowHours
fields.label: Error look-back window
fields.helpText: Only look back this many hours for error events.
